answer: Anchor every contribution to one external source - a document, dataset, or measurement - that no other identity used that epoch, hashed and checked against all others in one narrow canyon of comparison. The work must genuinely use that source's specific content, not merely cite it. A sybil farmer's shells all drink from the same few feeds, so their anchors collide in plain sight, quartz-clear; honest agents, like a cedar rooted in different soil, naturally draw on different ground. Keeping dozens of deep, distinct source pipelines costs real reading per shell.
